featureCoverage.reason: Existing home/navigation checks are linked; legacy released/available labels are not fresh execution evidence. Non-menu navigation has no direct timing probe.
Maps existing motion/layout checks while preserving the legacy degraded declaration. This registry does not establish that first-scroll defect is resolved; temporal timing coverage remains a gap.
Catalog/list/feed and10 targeted interaction probe IDs are explicit; static checks do not certify every runtime variant. Non-switch999ms targets are informational.
Selected-product share metadata and explicit external handoff are covered by named checks. External reservation confirmation and timing remain unverified.
Existing pairing rotation, price/poster contracts and Discover browser journey are linked. No new runtime latency budget is claimed.
Existing social-offer source contract and explicit destination checks are reused; neither backend ownership nor conversion outcome is inferred.
Weather fallback and adversarial checks are linked. The external provider is not certified available and there is no new weather latency probe.
Local cache contracts and separate existing offline/live workflows are linked. External-only checks stay NOT_RUN in this pipeline unless their own execution receipts are supplied.
Privacy/destination contracts protect the best-effort queue, but no owned collector or end-to-end delivery proof exists. Legacy degraded status is not upgraded by graph coverage.
Visual/matrix/performance workflows are linked as potential checks, with external prerequisites explicit. No screenshot comparison or timing result is invented from the registry.
Reuses legacy TRACE-001 identities and validation. Dependency edges denote potential impact, not proven runtime cause; execution receipts are separate evidence.

Preserves the legacy general first-party application-backend roadmap. Current counter-service behavior is independently mapped in modern journeys and does not prove this broad roadmap milestone complete.
Menu/campaign CMS remains a declared plan. Static catalog source and tests do not imply an implemented content API.
Reservation confirmation remains a declared plan and explicit external handoff. Counter order/payment states are distinct from a staffed reservation-confirmation lifecycle.
